channel.title: KEYCON Blog
channel.description: Practical guides for people who sell by chat and text.

item.title: How to Reply to Customers Faster: 9 Habits for Selling by Text and WhatsApp
item.description: Customers who message you are often messaging your competitors too. Nine practical habits to answer faster on WhatsApp, text and DMs without sounding like a robot.

item.title: 30 Sales Message Templates for WhatsApp and Text (Copy and Paste)
item.description: Ready-made sales messages for every stage: first reply, pricing, objections, follow-ups, payment, delivery and reviews. Copy them, adjust a few words and save them.

item.title: Real Estate Agents: How to Send Listings by Text in Seconds
item.description: Buyers text several agents at once. A practical system for real estate agents to send listing photos, prices and details by text or WhatsApp in seconds, and keep every lead moving.

item.title: Do Keyboard Apps Read What You Type? A Plain-English Guide to Keyboard Privacy
item.description: What a third-party keyboard can and can't see on iPhone and Android, what “Allow Full Access” really means, and a checklist to choose a keyboard app you can trust.
